summary: This creates a small square icon showing a classic terminal prompt symbol. It's a dark gray rounded square with a bright green greater-than sign in the center, styled to look like a retro command-line interface.

explanations.1: The viewBox sets up a 64×64 coordinate system, and the role and aria-label make this icon accessible to screen readers by describing what it represents.
explanations.2: The rect element draws the background box; rx and ry round the corners to give it a modern, slightly softer appearance.
explanations.3: text-anchor='middle' centers the text horizontally, and dominant-baseline='middle' centers it vertically within the 64×64 space.
